==Ingredients==

* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] roasted [[Cookbook:Sesame Oil|sesame oil]]
* ⅔ cup [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] greater [[Cookbook:Burdock|burdock]] root
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] freshly [[Cookbook:Grater|grated]] [[Cookbook:Ginger|ginger]]
* ⅔ cup chopped [[Cookbook:Lotus Root|lotus root]]
* ½ cup hatcho [[Cookbook:Miso|miso]]
* ⅔ cup chopped [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrots]]

==Procedure==
# Heat a pan and pour in the sesame oil.
# Add the greater burdock root, and [[Cookbook:Stir-frying|stir-fry]] for a few minutes.
#Add the carrots and the lotus root and stir-fry for a few minutes.
#Add miso and ginger. Turn down the heat and allow to cook over a low heat for 4 hours.
#Stir frequently until all water has evaporated and until the mixture appears dry and dark.
#Allow to cool and keep in a glass jar.
